maddeler.e:
أتناقض (form VI)
# أَتَنَاقَضُ (ʔatanāqaḍu) /ʔa.ta.naː.qa.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
# أَتَنَاقَضَ (ʔatanāqaḍa) /ʔa.ta.naː.qa.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
# أَتَنَاقَضْ (ʔatanāqaḍ) /ʔa.ta.naː.qadˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاقَضَ (tanāqaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
